# Tobi Oladimeji

> Data. AI. Product. Data, AI, and product professional, entrepreneur, and Founder & CEO of Data Fellows, based in Waterloo Region, Ontario, Canada.

Tobi is a data, AI, and product professional, entrepreneur, and Founder & CEO of Data Fellows, a software, data, and AI company solving complex operational problems, backed by a global community of 1,600+ professionals across 33+ countries. He has worked across data, AI, and product at PwC, ESGTree, Granted Technologies, AgroMall, and Cohere, and founded Inscend, an AI-powered B2B SaaS platform for ecommerce merchants, from November 2025 to November 2026.

## Current role

- **Data Fellows** (https://datafellowsai.com/): Founder & CEO, Aug 2022 to present. A software, data, and AI company building technology to solve complex operational problems, backed by a global community of 1,600+ professionals across 33+ countries.
- **Cohere**: AI Data Trainer, independent contractor, Oct 2026 to present. Supports machine learning data quality and evaluation workflows.

Tobi is open to the right opportunities in data, AI, and product, technical collaborations, and conversations about complex organizational problems, alongside running Data Fellows.

## Past ventures

- **Inscend** (https://www.inscend.io/): Founder, Nov 2025 to Nov 2026. Founded and launched an AI-powered B2B SaaS platform for ecommerce merchants. Led a distributed engineering team, engaged 50+ founders, ran Shopify merchant pilots, secured early paying customers, and established a development and referral agreement with SHOPLINE. Finalist at SAAS NORTH AI PitchFest and OBSIDI BFUTR 2026. This venture concluded in November 2026; it is not an active product and is not currently accepting customers.
- **BizPilot AI**: an early experiment built through Data Fellows, started in 2025. Initially explored a marketplace connecting businesses with data professionals, then shifted toward AI-powered decision intelligence for small businesses. That work later informed Inscend. It was not an independent company or separate employment.
- **Venture Learning Collective**: Co-Founder, Feb 2026 to Jul 2026, concluded. Helped establish a venture-building and funding-readiness initiative for early founders. Secured a C$2,800 micro-grant from Weston Frontlines and delivered the Youth Funding Readiness Lab with GRANTED (six virtual sessions, May 27 to Jun 25, 2026, 10-participant core cohort, 8 active throughout, final reporting in July 2026).
- **Granted Technologies Inc.**: Strategic Advisor (Head of Data Ops), Oct 2025 to Aug 2026, contract, part-time. Advised on scalable data systems and automation for grant discovery, extraction, and reporting, leading data strategy, workflow design, and operational systems to support large-scale grant intelligence.

## Background

Earlier roles: Data Analyst & Machine Learning Engineer at ESGTree (Power BI, SQL/Python, LLM-based document extraction, Feb 2024 to Sep 2024), Data Analyst at PwC (Dynamics AX to Dynamics 365 F&O migration, Sep 2022 to Nov 2023), and data/BI analyst roles at Rollback Ally, Metridash, Analytic Company GmbH, Quantum Analytics NG, and AgroMall. Postgraduate Diploma in Business Analytics from Conestoga College (2024); B.Sc. in Computer Science from Landmark University (2022).

Selected into multiple global and Canadian accelerator and founder-in-residence programs supporting product development, growth, and fundraising, alongside Data Fellows and Inscend: BHive (GEIP), Accelerator Centre (RevLab), League of Innovators (LOI), Emerging Leaders Collective (ELC), and LvlUp Ventures (Labs). These were accelerator/recognition programs, not employment.

## Notable projects

- **Data Fellows**: a software, data, and AI company solving complex operational problems, backed by a global community of 1,600+ professionals across 33+ countries.
- **Inscend**: historical product work, see Past ventures above.
- **Granted Source Agent** and **Inscend Source Agent**: Gemini-powered AI agents (with Google Search grounding) that discover and score non-dilutive funding opportunities and leads, respectively.
- **PwC: Enterprise Data Transformation** and **ESGTree: Applied AI & Document Extraction**: case studies built from the employer work described above.
- Several Power BI, SQL, and Python data-analysis projects, listed at https://tobioladimeji.com/#work.
